remarks: Discover this well-maintained brick home in Norwalk's 06851 zip code - 3 bedrooms, 2 full baths, ~1,590 sq ft (and a spacious semi-finished lower level) - priced at $589,000.  Zoned for two-family use though currently configured as a single family - ideal for rental income or multigenerational living. "Conversion to legal two-family may require permit" Finished lower level (~700 sq ft) features full bath and kitchen area - for in-laws or tenants. Large back yard plus 1-car attached garage.  Recent Updates: New windows throughout (2025) Fresh paint inside & out. New gutters & leaders. Hardwood floors refinished on main level. New carpeting and lighting in lower level living/bedroom area. New vanities and new flooring in porch. Additional Features: Attic with walk-up stairs: ready for storage or future living space. Hot-water (oil) heating system; public sewer; concrete perimeter foundation. Brick construction (built 1950) offers durability and low maintenance. Lifestyle: Home is located with convenient access to I-95, Route 7 and the Metro-North train, you'll enjoy city commuting ease with suburban comfort. Large yard, brick construction, and the finished lower level make this home a rare find in this price bracket. Don't miss this opportunity - homes in this zone and size rarely hit the market.
